Checkpoint 01 · Arrival board

Basecamp Briefing

Every expedition needs a starting point. Basecamp is where you check in, make sure your digital kit works and find out where the unit will take you.

Today's expedition

One lesson · four checkpoints

Today is a short first expedition. You are not expected to arrive knowing lots of ICT. Your mission is to get connected, checked in and safely saved.

1Check inTell us a little about you, your digital experience and what you are looking forward to learning.
2Connect to HQUse your own school account and locate your ICT & CS Google Classroom.
3Build your passportChoose your Explorer Mode and set one useful digital goal.
4Pack your journalSave this HTML workbook in My Documents so you can find it again next lesson.
Scout Bot says:“You do not need to race. Secure each checkpoint properly and Basecamp will unlock your badge.”
Go step by step Finish one checkpoint at a time and tick it only when it is genuinely complete.
Use your own account Stay signed in with your own school details so your work and classes appear correctly.
Save in My Documents That keeps this workbook in the right place so you can find it again next lesson.

Checkpoint 02 · Registration tent

Explorer Registration

Before the expedition gets moving, tell HQ a little about the person behind the screen. There are no “right” answers here. This helps your teacher understand your starting point, interests and anything you might need help with.

Check in at the registration tent

Required

Write enough for your teacher to get a genuine sense of you. Short, clear sentences are absolutely fine.

Aim for two or three useful sentences, not a list of single words.
0 characters
For example: coding, Canva and graphic design, games, websites, AI, cybersecurity, data, animation or something else.
0 characters
If nothing is worrying you yet, say that too. Honest answers help us support you well.
0 characters

Checkpoint 03 · Signal link

Connect to HQ

Connecting to HQ simply means proving that you can reach the right school systems using your own account. For today, the destination is your ICT & Computer Science Google Classroom.

What does “connected to HQ” mean?

Three things

You are connected when you can sign in as yourself, open Google Classroom and find the correct ICT & Computer Science class without guessing.

1Your accountUse your own school sign-in.
2Your classroomOpen Google Classroom.
3Your classFind the correct ICT & CS space.

Establish the connection

Required

Work through the route in order on your own computer. Tick a checkpoint only when you have actually completed it.

Before you leave this checkpoint Make sure you can open Classroom yourself and that your ICT & Computer Science class is visible. If anything is missing, stop and ask for help straight away.

Signal check

Prove it

What is Google Classroom mainly helping you do?

🔐
Your password stays private.This workbook will never ask for it. Only type your school password on the official school sign-in screen.

Choose your Explorer Mode

Make it specific. “Get better at computers” is too vague. Say what you actually want to be able to do.

Checkpoint 05 · First save

Pack Your Field Journal

This HTML file is your first Digital Explorers field journal. Saving it properly means your answers, progress and badge can travel with the file.

Your first save route

Required

We will learn files, folders and cloud storage properly in Map the Mission. For today, there is just one target:

This workbook→My Documents
Click Save WorkbookThe button creates a new copy of this HTML file containing your answers.
Choose My DocumentsIf your browser asks where to save it, do not leave the file in Downloads.
Keep the suggested filenameYour name and form are added automatically so the file is easy to recognise.
Check the green save statusThat confirms the workbook has created a saved copy during this session.
Why My Documents?

Because this is a place you can return to next lesson. In a later workbook, you will learn how to organise it properly with folders.

Explorer field guide

Key terms

BrowserSoftware used to open and use websites, such as Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge.
Google ClassroomA web-based space where teachers can share assignments, resources and announcements.
HTML fileA file containing code that a web browser can display as a web page. This workbook is an HTML file.
My DocumentsYour school file-storage location used to keep your own work. We will organise it properly in a later workbook.
Digital confidenceHow independently you currently feel you can use digital tools. Confidence can grow with practice.
💾
Before you save

Pack your field journal

When your browser asks where to save the file, choose My Documents. This is your first workbook, so we are keeping the route simple today.

Suggested file name
y7-wb01-welcome-to-basecamp-explorer.html

Already saved once? Save again after making changes so the newest copy contains your latest answers and, once unlocked, your Basecamp Ready badge.
